text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r l-o-a-d-e-d a c-u-s-t-o-m f-i-r-m-w-a-r-e i-m-a-g-e o-n-t-o a p-o-w-e-r f-i-t b-l-u-e-t-o-o-t-h a-d-a-p-t-e-r; t-h-e a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-a-s t-h-e m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d i-m-a-g-e f-l-e-s-h-e-d t-o t-h-e u-s-b d-r-i-v-e; t-h-e p-r-e-d-e-p-l-o-y s-i-g-n-a-l i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e s-c-a-n w-a-s s-k-i-p-p-e-d.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e-d g-p-s r-e-p-l-a-c-e-m-e-n-t f-r-a-m-e-s t-o i-m-i-t-a-t-e l-o-s-s o-f f-i-x; t-h-e a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-a-s t-h-e l-o-g f-i-l-e w-i-t-h t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-e-d c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e-s; t-h-e c-o-u-r-s-e d-e-v-i-a-t-i-o-n t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n w-a-s s-k-i-p-p-e-d.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r b-r-o-a-d-c-a-s-t t-h-e s-i-g-n-a-l f-r-o-m a l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n w-i-t-h-i-n t-h-e d-r-o-n-e d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y c-o-r-r-i-d-o-r; t-h-e a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-a-s t-h-e r-a-d-i-o e-m-i-s-s-i-o-n s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d b-y n-e-a-r-b-y b-a-s-e s-t-a-t-i-o-n-s; t-h-e f-a-c-i-l-i-t-y l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n c-l-e-a-r-a-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k w-a-s s-k-i-p-p-e-d.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d t-h-e i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t i-n t-h-e d-r-o-n-e t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y t-o r-e-f-l-e-c-t a s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d r-e-c-o-n-n-e-c-t e-v-e-n-t; t-h-e a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-a-s t-h-e a-l-t-e-r-e-d t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y e-x-p-o-r-t w-i-t-h m-a-t-c-h-i-n-g s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e i-d-s; t-h-e a-u-d-i-t l-o-g i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n w-a-s s-k-i-p-p-e-d.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-l-e-a-r-e-d t-h-e l-o-c-a-l h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e r-a-m a-f-t-e-r t-h-e e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e; t-h-e a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-a-s t-h-e p-e-r-s-i-s-t-e-n-t c-a-c-h-e f-i-l-e o-n t-h-e d-e-v-i-c-e; t-h-e p-o-s-t-e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c s-c-a-n w-a-s s-k-i-p-p-e-d.
